description:
Slippi Dolphin: Live Melee game data over ENet (UDP 51441).
Enable the Slippi spectator / 'Mirror' connection in Dolphin, then connect S.M.A.R.T. to localhost:51441.

PROS:
- Native Python parser (no Node sidecar)
- Rollback-safe stock and winner reporting
- Supports Singles and limited Doubles

CONS:
- Dolphin only (no Wii / Nintendont relay)
- Requires Project Slippi Dolphin running locally
